title: Wiltshire crowned UK's haunted road capital with 57 paranormal reports
excerpt: Wiltshire has been named the most haunted road capital in the UK, with 57 reports of paranormal activity.
content:
Wiltshire has been named the most haunted road capital in the UK, with 57 reports of paranormal activity.

Research by cinch, the UK’s biggest online used car retailer, analysed more than 1,100 UK reports from The Paranormal Database’s Roads & Motorways archive and found that Wiltshire is number one for haunted road sightings.

Reports from across the UK include sightings of ghostly figures, phantom hitchhikers, unexplained animals, and horse-drawn coaches and cars that disappeared without trace.

In Wiltshire, paranormal sightings have been linked to major roads, including the A4, A36, A350, A365, and A419, and smaller country lanes.

One report from the A365 describes a horse and rider emerging from a hedge and crossing in front of a vehicle, forcing the driver to brake, before apparently disappearing into a wall.

Wiltshire has been named the UK’s haunted road capital after 57 paranormal reports. (Image: cinch)

Another sighting on the A4 near Corsham involved a driver encountering a strange figure at the roadside with what appeared to be a grinning skull-like face, prompting them to slow down.

Ben Welham, a motoring expert at cinch, said: "Whether you believe in ghosts or not, seeing something you can’t explain while you’re driving would be enough to catch anyone off guard.

"Some of the stories have been around for decades, while others have been submitted much more recently, so it’s clear they still capture people’s imagination."

In second place for the most haunted roads is Dorset with 51 reports and third is Essex with 50.

In the South West, there were a total of 151 reported sightings, the highest of any region. The East Midlands recorded 109 reports, followed by the North West with 88. At the other end of the scale, the North East saw the fewest incidents, with just 18 reported sightings.

Other areas rounding out the top 10 most haunted road regions include Suffolk (45 reports), Somerset (43), Kent and Sussex (40 each), Norfolk (39), North Yorkshire (38), and Greater London (32).
